records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2025, product sales decreased by $32.8 million, or 13.2%, to $216.2 million, compared to $249.0 million for the three months ended June 30, 2024, due to a decrease in average selling prices and a decrease in total volume sold of 3.3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Home heating oil consumers are sensitive to heating cost increases, and this often leads to customer conservation and increased gross customer losses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result as of March 31, 2025, we increased delivery and branch expense and recorded a payable under those weather hedge contracts of $3.1 million, and paid the amount in full in April 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a commodity, the price of home heating oil is generally impacted by many factors, including economic and geopolitical forces, tariff regimes and is closely linked to the price of diesel fuel.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of March 31, 2024, we reduced delivery and branch expenses and recorded a receivable of $7.5 million under the weather hedge contract, and received the amount in full in April 2024.
